newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated sees premium cigar sales higher.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated sees premium cigar sales higher.

text.p: Consolidated Cigar Holdings Inc said Monday it expected premium cigars sales to account for more than 40 percent of its total sales dollars this year.
"Premium cigars are driving our business now and should do so through 1997," it said.
A premium cigar sells for more than $1 a piece.
The company declined to disclose the percentage figure for the prior year on the premium cigar's contribution to net sales.
The company reported first-quarter earnings of $0.27 a share against $0.18 -- or $0.14 on a pro forma basis -- for the same period last year.
Net sales totaled $55.9 million against $40.2 million.
